meta.description: Languages and Scripts (Sprachen und Schriften) from TDE 4.1. Each language and script is an individual talent. Heroes start with their mother tongue at CL-2, and may know a second language at CL-4. Languages from the same family as the mother tongue cost 75% of normal AP to advance (round up). Scripts and foreign languages from other families cost one column higher to advance. Advancement column A. Tests are rare — TP measures communication complexity.

talents.name: Tongues (Mother Tongue)
talents.description: Every Aventurian hero knows their mother tongue at a starting value of CL-2. TP 1: can identify the language. TP 2: basic communication (Me hungry!). TP 4: simple sentences. TP = 1/3 complexity: fluent communication including all common grammatical constructions. TP = 1/2 complexity: near-native proficiency (slight accent remains). Tests will be rare; TP mainly measures communication complexity.

talents.name: Tongues — Garethi
talents.description: Garethi is the current standard language and most important trade language of Aventuria. Maximum complexity: 18. Script: Kuslik Signs. Language family: Garethi Family (also includes Bosparano, Alaani). Same-family languages are 75% cost to advance (round up) as long as TP does not exceed mother-tongue TP. Heroes from Garetia start with this as their mother tongue.

talents.name: Tongues — Tulamidya
talents.description: Tulamidya is the second most important trade language of Aventuria. Maximum complexity: 18. Script: Sacred Glyphs of Unau or 'Classical' Tulamidya depending on region and religion. Language family: Tulamidyan Family (also includes Proto-Tulamidyan). Heroes from Tulamidyan cultures start with this as their mother tongue.

talents.name: Tongues — Bosparano
talents.description: Bosparano was the standard language of the Old Empire (Bosparanisches Reich), now used mostly for ritual and scholarly purposes. Complexity: 21. Script: Kuslik Signs (later form). Language family: Garethi Family. Requires Language Lore to advance beyond TP 10 for non-native speakers.

talents.name: Tongues — Thorwalian
talents.description: Thorwalian developed from Hjaldingar (Saga Thorwalian) and in modern times has absorbed many Garethian loan words. Complexity: 18. Script: Kuslik Signs. No formal language family (standalone). Heroes from Thorwalian cultures start with this as their mother tongue.

talents.name: Tongues — Isdira
talents.description: Isdira is spoken by all elven peoples. It has 27 intricate letter signs (complexity 21) and is descended from the far more complex Asdharia. Requires Language Lore 7 to advance beyond TP 18 (for speakers of related languages); non-native speakers need Language Lore 7 for TP above 10. No formal language family (standalone).

talents.name: Tongues — Rogolan
talents.description: Rogolan is used by the dwarfs, based on 24 angular dwarfen runes (complexity 21). Language family: standalone. Note: Rogolan is column B for most heroes as it is from a different language family; this is reflected in the advancement_column. Dwarfs start with this as their mother tongue (then column A).

talents.name: Tongues — Orkish
talents.description: Orkish has no written form and is subdivided into the 'high' Ologhaijan (complexity 15) and the common Oloarkh (complexity 10). No language family (standalone). Orcs start with Oloarkh as their mother tongue.

talents.name: Tongues — Goblinic
talents.description: Goblinic has no written form. Complexity: 12. No language family (standalone). Goblins start with this as their mother tongue.

talents.name: Tongues — Nujuka
talents.description: Nujuka is the spoken-only language of the Nivese people (complexity 15). No written form exists. No language family (standalone).

talents.name: Tongues — Mohic
talents.description: Mohic is used as a cover term for the various dialects of the woodsmen (no written form; complexity 15). No language family (standalone).

talents.name: Tongues — Proto-Tulamidya
talents.description: Proto-Tulamidya has been a dead language for about 1,000 years. Complexity: 21. Script: 300 syllabic signs, letters, and diacritic marks (see script entry). Language family: Tulamidyan. Requires Language Lore 7 to advance beyond TP 18 (within family) or TP 10 (outside family).

talents.name: Tongues — Alaani
talents.description: Alaani is the complex language of the Norbards (nomads). Complexity: 21. It has no alphabet of its own, usually using Kuslik Signs instead. Language family: Garethi Family. Norbard heroes start with this as their mother tongue.

talents.name: Tongues — Rssahh
talents.description: Rssahh is the common tongue of all scaly folk (achaz/lizardfolk). Complexity: 18. Script: Chrmk. No language family (standalone).

talents.name: Tongues — Zhayad
talents.description: Zhayad is the secret cipher language of magicians (with its own phonetic/syllabic script; complexity 15). It is said to be the only language that allows communication with demons. No language family (standalone). Column B for those without magical training.

talents.name: Tongues — Atak
talents.description: Atak is a sign and symbol language (complexity 12) used by Tulamidyan merchants as well as thieves and beggars. No language family (standalone).

talents.name: Tongues — Vixish
talents.description: Vixish (thieves' cant) is composed of common words with new meanings and has no written form, except for a set of warning signs collectively known as 'marks' (Zinken). Complexity: 12. Includes knowledge of the marks. No language family (standalone).

talents.name: Read/Write — Kuslik Signs
talents.description: Kuslik Signs: 31 letters; complexity 10. Used for Garethi, Bosparano, Thorwalian, Alaani, and others. TP 0: cannot read/write. TP 1-2: can identify some letters. TP = 1/3 complexity (here ~3-4): can read/write short sentences. TP = 1/2 complexity (5+): everyday texts fluently. Maximum TP = complexity (10). Scripts from different language families cost one column higher to advance beyond the base column.

talents.name: Read/Write — Tulamidyan Script
talents.description: Modern Tulamidya: 56 syllabic signs; complexity 14. Used for Tulamidya and some religious texts. Maximum TP = 14. Scripts from different language families cost one column higher to advance for non-family speakers.

talents.name: Read/Write — Sacred Glyphs of Unau
talents.description: Sacred Glyphs of Unau: 19 letters and diacritic marks; complexity 13. Used by certain Tulamidyan religious traditions. Maximum TP = 13.

talents.name: Read/Write — Isdira Script
talents.description: Isdira script: 27 letters plus many subtle diacritic marks; complexity 15. Used for the elven language Isdira. Maximum TP = 15. Generally available only to elves and those taught by them.

talents.name: Read/Write — Dwarfen Runes (Rogolan)
talents.description: Rogolan (Dwarfen Runes): 20–24 angular letters with some alternate values; complexity 11. Used for the dwarfen language Rogolan. Maximum TP = 11.

talents.name: Read/Write — Proto-Tulamidyan
talents.description: Proto-Tulamidyan script: 300 syllabic signs, letters and diacritic marks; complexity 16. To decipher individual letters, TP 2 is needed; short sentences word-by-word at TP 6; understanding a decree of a Diamond Sultan requires TP 8 (plus knowledge of the language itself). Maximum TP = 16.

talents.name: Read/Write — Nanduria
talents.description: Nanduria script: 26 letters; complexity 10. Maximum TP = 10.

talents.name: Read/Write — Hjaldingr Runes
talents.description: Hjaldingr Runes: letters and pictographs; complexity 10. Used for Saga-Thorwalian / Hjaldingar. Maximum TP = 10.

talents.name: Read/Write — Asdharia
talents.description: Asdharia script: uses the Isdira letters slightly altered, plus changed diacritics and complex ligatures; complexity 18. Basis for Isdira. Language Lore 7 required to advance Asdharia (language) beyond TP 18 for related speakers; non-native speakers need Language Lore 7 for TP above 10. Advancement column B for non-family speakers (Isdira family).

talents.name: Read/Write — Chrmk (Zelemja)
talents.description: Chrmk (Zelemja): over 5,000 highly complex signs; complexity 18. Used for the Rssahh language of the scaly folk. Advancement column B for non-scaly-folk characters.

talents.name: Read/Write — Zhayad Script
talents.description: Zhayad script: phonetic/syllabic; complexity 15. The secret script of magicians, used for the cipher language Zhayad. Maximum TP = 15. Column B for non-mages.
